findings.claim: Lear 2009 gross margin 3.7% (gross profit $360M) vs 5.5% ($748M) in 2008; Q1 2009 gross margin was -3.5% (gross loss $76M); 9M2009 sales fell 36.2% YoY to $7.0B.

findings.claim: Genuine Parts (distributor, not a pure supplier) fell 50.8% peak-to-trough Sep 2007 to Mar 2009 (recovered Dec 2010) and 52.7% in Jan-Mar 2020 (recovered Jan 2021); no Lear-specific stock drawdown or cycle length found.
findings.source: Trefis, Genuine Parts Stock Drop Looks Sharp, But How Deep Can It Go?
